parsed.answer: The evidence excerpts do not address spider silk. Source [18987782] concerns Myc oncogenic activity and ribosomal protein haploinsufficiency in mice, and source [6836086] concerns outer membrane protein biogenesis in Escherichia coli. Neither identifies a silk structural protein (e.g., spidroin) nor describes any industrial harvesting method, so the claim cannot be assessed from this corpus.
